# phData

> phData is an enterprise data and AI consulting firm specializing in data engineering, analytics, machine learning, and generative AI solutions built on Snowflake and modern cloud platforms.

phData provides end-to-end services spanning data strategy, engineering, analytics, MLOps, and AI implementation. The firm is a Snowflake partner and dbt Labs Partner of Year, offering both consulting services and accelerated solutions for enterprise customers across healthcare, manufacturing, energy, and financial services.

## Key Topics

- Snowflake Data Cloud
- Data Engineering
- Machine Learning & AI
- Generative AI & LLMs
- DataOps & MLOps
- Data Strategy
- Business Intelligence
- Elastic Operations
- Data Migrations
- FinOps & Cost Optimization
- dbt
- Tableau & Sigma
- Customer Data Platforms
- Workflow Automation
- Enterprise Solutions

## Core Services

- [Data Engineering Services](https://www.phdata.io/data-engineering): phData data engineering services for Snowflake and modern platforms
- [AI and Machine Learning Services](https://www.phdata.io/ai-machine-learning): End-to-end AI and ML services from phData data scientists
- [Generative AI Services](https://www.phdata.io/generative-ai-services): phData's generative AI services and LLM applications for enterprise
- [Data Strategy Services](https://www.phdata.io/strategy-services): Data, analytics, and AI strategy advisory and implementation planning
- [Analytics and BI Services](https://www.phdata.io/analytics-agentic-activation): Analytics, visualization, and BI services with Tableau and Snowflake
- [Data Migrations](https://www.phdata.io/data-migrations): phData's cloud and Snowflake data migration automation services

## Operations & Platform Management

- [Elastic Operations](https://www.phdata.io/elastic-operations): Managed DataOps, MLOps, and Snowflake operational excellence services
- [AWS Elastic Platform Operations](https://www.phdata.io/solutions/aws-elastic-platform-operations): AWS managed data platform operations with 24/7 certified support
- [FinOps - Snowflake Cost Optimization](https://www.phdata.io/solutions/finops-snowflake-cost-optimization): FinOps and Snowflake cost optimization with phData Advisor tool
